approved_classes.ex:AminoAcid: The class of all amino acids.
approved_classes.ex:EssentialAminoAcid: A subclass of AminoAcid that are not produced by the body and must be obtained through food.
approved_classes.ex:NonEssentialAminoAcid: A subclass of AminoAcid that are produced by the body and do not require supplementation.
approved_classes.ex:SemiEssentialAminoAcid: A subclass of AminoAcid that are produced by the body but in insufficient amounts.
approved_classes.ex:BranchedChainAminoAcid: A subclass of AminoAcid that have branched aliphatic side chains.
approved_classes.ex:HydroxylGroupContainingAminoAcid: A subclass of AminoAcid that contain hydroxyl groups.
approved_classes.ex:SulfurContainingAminoAcid: A subclass of AminoAcid that contain sulfur.
approved_classes.ex:AcidicAminoAcid: A subclass of AminoAcid that are acidic in nature.
approved_classes.ex:BasicAminoAcid: A subclass of AminoAcid that are basic in nature.
approved_classes.ex:AromaticAminoAcid: A subclass of AminoAcid that have aromatic rings.
approved_classes.ex:IminoAminoAcid: A subclass of AminoAcid that have an imino group.
approved_classes.ex:HeterocyclicAminoAcid: A subclass of AminoAcid that have heterocyclic rings.
approved_classes.ex:PurelyKetogenicAminoAcid: A subclass of AminoAcid that are purely ketogenic.
approved_classes.ex:KetogenicAndGlucogenicAminoAcid: A subclass of AminoAcid that are ketogenic and glucogenic.
approved_classes.ex:PurelyGlucogenicAminoAcid: A subclass of AminoAcid that are purely glucogenic.
approved_classes.ex:NonPolarAminoAcid: A subclass of AminoAcid that are non-polar.
approved_classes.ex:PolarAminoAcidWithNoCharge: A subclass of AminoAcid that are polar with no charge on 'R' group.
approved_classes.ex:PolarAminoAcidWithPositiveCharge: A subclass of AminoAcid that are polar with positive charge on 'R' group.
approved_classes.ex:PolarAminoAcidWithNegativeCharge: A subclass of AminoAcid that are polar with negative charge on 'R' group.
approved_classes.ex:Cysteine: A subclass of AminoAcid that contains a mercapto group.
approved_classes.ex:Cystine: A subclass of AminoAcid that is the disulfide bond form of Cysteine.
approved_classes.ex:Diiodothyronine: A subclass of Hormone that is a type of medicine used to help people reduce weight, lower cholesterol, and develop muscle.
approved_classes.ex:D-Penicillamine: A subclass of Drug that is a metabolite of penicillin used in chelation therapy of Wilson’s disease.
approved_classes.ex:Gabapentin: A subclass of Anticonvulsant that is used as an anticonvulsant.
approved_classes.ex:Histidine: A subclass of AminoAcid that is critical for baby feeding and can reduce blood pressure.
approved_classes.ex:N-Acetylcysteine: A subclass of Drug that is used in cystic fibrosis and chronic renal insufficiency as an antioxidant.
approved_classes.ex:Ornithine: A subclass of AminoAcid that is primarily used in health supplements to support sports and performance.
approved_classes.ex:Proline: A subclass of AminoAcid that is one of the most important reasons to use L-proline supplements for joint and skin health.
approved_classes.ex:Tyrosine: A subclass of AminoAcid that is commonly used in the production of thyroid hormone.
